name: Lightning Round
description: A buzzer round plus two guess-the-number questions. Bring about 5 quick questions to ask out loud.

intro.message:
LIGHTNING ROUND!

First: a buzzer round, your teacher asks about 5 questions out loud. Buzz fast, answer faster. Wrong answers are locked out until the next question.

Then: guess-the-number. Closest guess wins the points.

buzzer.prompt: Listen for the question, then BUZZ!

guess1.prompt: How many liters of water does a cow drink in a single day?

guess2.prompt: In what year was the very first text message sent?

end.message: That's the Lightning Round! Rematch anytime.

recommendedFor: Zero-prep energizer, any subject. Out of questions? Starter pack: How many bones in an adult human body? (206) · What's the largest planet? (Jupiter) · How many strings on a standard guitar? (6) · What year did the first iPhone launch? (2007) · How many continents are there? (7)
